feeds.title: My Colombian Recipes
feeds.description: My Colombian Recipes is a culinary haven curated by Erica since February 2009. Delve into a treasure trove of hundreds of cherished Colombian and Latin recipes, crafted with love from her family's kitchen to yours. Erica's mission is to unveil the rich tapestry of Colombian cuisine, inviting global explorers to savour the flavours and absorb the cultural nuances embedded in each dish.

feeds.title: Muy Bueno Cookbook
feeds.description: Hola, I'm Yvette, an on-camera host, a home chef, an Emmy-winning producer and writer, award-winning food blogger. Here on Muy Bueno, I share delicious home-style Mexican recipes served with a heaping spoonful of heartwarming family stories. For me, food has become a way to share my cultural heritage and childhood memories with my family.

feeds.title: Sweet Life
feeds.description: Vianney is an Award-Winning Food Blogger, Recipe Developer, and the Author of The Tex-Mex Slow Cooker and Latin Twist. Here in South Texas, people love to entertain and spend time in the company of good people. Her blog Sweet Life is a celebration of that connection and the vibrant, unique culture of South Texas.

feeds.title: Isabel Eats
feeds.description: Here at Isabel Eats, you'll find a mix of all your favorite authentic Mexican recipes as well as Mexican-inspired dishes with a twist! Anything from Mexican Stuffed Peppers and a Healthy Avocado Salad to ooey-gooey cheesy Red Chicken Enchiladas and delicious Tres Leches Cake!

feeds.title: My Dominican Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: I'm Vanessa and it is my pleasure to welcome you to My Dominican Kitchen, a bilingual food blog where we help busy moms put together tasty traditional Dominican and Latin-inspired meals without having to spend tons of time in the kitchen. Browse hundreds of authentic delicious dishes all with detailed step-by-step tutorials and expert tips!

feeds.title: La Cocina Chilena de Pilar Hernández
feeds.description: My name is Pilar Hernandez. I am a Latina living in Houston, Texas. In 2003 I arrived from Chile. The blog was born in 2008 initially as a space to keep track of the recipes I cooked and my opinions about what I thought. The blog's recipe book is organized into Sweet Things, Salty Things and Chilean Recipes

feeds.title: Cocina Republic
feeds.description: Unleash your inner Latin culinary hobbyist with a trove full of recipe ideas and insights At Cocina Republic, you'll find mouth-watering Latin recipes, get inspired, and become part of a community that shares your passion for Latin cuisine. Blog author Olga Munoz is a food enthusiast who loves cooking, traveling, and exploring new cuisines.

feeds.title: HOMEMADE FOOD IS TRUE LOVE MADE EDIBLE
feeds.description: Welcome to Camila Made! My name is Camila Benitez. Here, I share our family's favorite recipes, all tried and loved, from holiday feasts and entertaining to everyday family meals and plenty of baked goods! My recipes are designed to be approachable and simple to prepare, using readily available ingredients that can be found in any local supermarket.

feeds.title: Pilar's Chilean Food & Garden
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Pilar Hernandez. I was born and raised in Chile and moved to Houston, Texas, in 2003 without knowing how to cook and speaking no English. Today, I'm a cookbook author and leader of 2 community gardens. I will show you how to cook Chilean food with ingredients you find in your supermarket. I'll challenge you to try exotic fruits like lucuma or maqui, our favorite cereals, wheat berries, and quinoa.

feeds.title: Laylita's Recipes
feeds.description: Find easy and delicious recipes from Latin America and around the world on the blog. Layla Pujol is an Ecuadorian modern-day nomad who loves to cook and travel. She currently lives in Europe, previously in the US, and is currently working on her first cookbook, which will focus on delicious Ecuadorian and Latin recipes.

feeds.title: Mommy's Home Cooking
feeds.description: I'm Oriana, the face behind Mommy's Home Cooking. I started this blog in the summer of 2011. As a self-taught cook/baker myself, Mommy's Home Cooking has become a trusted resource for food lovers. born and raised in Caracas, Venezuela, where food goes far beyond just feeding the family. The food is an essential element of my culture, which presents love and tradition ...values that I'm committed to passing down to my kids.

feeds.title: Nibbles and Feasts
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ericka! Cookbook author, award-winning blogger, recipe developer and photographer. I'm a bicultural mom born in Mexico, raised in Texas and now living in Los Angeles, CA. Nibbles and Feasts were created to preserve and share my favourite traditional family recipes and new recipes inspired by my life in Los Angeles.

feeds.title: La Piña en la Cocina
feeds.description: My name is Sonia Mendez Garcia. On my blog La Pina en la Cocina, I embrace my Mexican heritage and share all the wonderful flavours, colours and foods I grew up with. Join me on this journey as I also learn new foods and cooking techniques. Dedicated to my parents Ramiro and Blanca.

feeds.title: Dominican Cooking
feeds.description: Dominican Cooking is all about Aunt Clara's traditional Dominican recipes and recipes by Tia Clara inspired by the food culture of the Dominican Republic.

feeds.title: Cooking with Books
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Marnely Murray. Welcome to Cooking with Books, where we'll discover the joy of cooking, eating, and travelling together! I work as a Pastry Chef at a private golf club during the warm weather season - meaning May through October, alongside my husband. I'm a food columnist for our local newspaper, The Martha's Vineyard Times.

feeds.title: Confieso Que Cocino
feeds.description: Hi, I am Pilar Woloszyn. Self-taught in the kitchen, I have embarked on this journey of no return, through markets, kitchens, books and places, where I take what I like to adapt and transform it into a rich dish, from the perspective of a housewife. With doubts and weaknesses, which I am clearing and fighting to finally deliver them to the blog.

feeds.title: Lola's Cocina
feeds.description: Dolores Wiarco Dweck, known by Lola, has a great appreciation for Mexican cuisine and culture. Lola's culinary mentors include her relatives and friends as well as some of Mexico's great chefs and home cooks. Follow her blog where she preserves and shares her favorite recipes through Lola's Cocina.

feeds.title: Easy and Delish
feeds.description: Hello! I am Denise Browning, I am a professional Chef with expertise in Brazilian food. I am also a busy mom of two girls, living in Texas. Here you will find budget-friendly, healthy Brazilian and Global Recipes made Easy and Delish! I would love to help you feed your family healthy dinners with a few splurges because life is all about balance! Join our community and happy cooking!

feeds.title: My Latina Table
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Charbel! Welcome to My Latina Table! Here you will find a wide variety of content that anyone can enjoy, with a principal focus on sharing authentic Mexican recipes that anyone can make. My Latina Table is the best place to find truly authentic Mexican recipes and more; from breakfast to dinner, to dessert and more.

feeds.title: The Noshery
feeds.description: Welcome to The Noshery! I'm Meseidy. I created The Noshery in 2008 after realizing how much my husband and I missed the food back home in Puerto Rico. Here you'll find recipes that are always from scratch, ideas inspired by my travels, and cooking techniques I've learned along my journey from home-cook to chef - plus some life misadventures, DIY and craft tips, and doggie shenanigans thrown in to keep you on your toes.

feeds.title: La Cocina de Vero
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Veronica CerveraI. I was born in Cuba and have been living in Miami for 21 years. My passions are food and travel, and I'm always testing and developing new recipes. Every dish on this blog is homemade and has been tested before being published.

feeds.title: The Sofrito Project
feeds.description: In 2017, Reina Gascon-Lopez started The Sofrito Project to share her love of cooking with friends and family. As a Puerto Rican raised in the South, Reina explores both her multiracial background and cultures through food and writing. Bridging the cultures of her Afro-Caribbean, Latin, and Southern upbringing allows for creativity in the kitchen with her flavorful and delicious recipes and digital cookbooks that her readers enjoy.

feeds.title: TastyAZ » Latin Food
feeds.description: TastyAZ is your source to get hands-on authentic Latina cuisine recipes. Find step by step recipes of sweet, savoury, spicy and more dishes. I'm Isabel, a makeup fanatic, movie lover, traveller, foodie, living with my family here in beautiful Arizona! And Tasty AZ is a lifestyle blog focused on food and travel. This blog is a place to highlight and support local restaurants and document my food creations and travel adventures.

feeds.title: La Salsa Inglesa
feeds.description: At La Salsa Inglesa, we believe that Latin American cuisine should be celebrated and enjoyed by people around the globe, including those who are unfamiliar with its delicious food. La Salsa Inglesa brings you simple recipes with easy-to-find, wholesome ingredients. We select vignettes, articles, and anecdotes to inspire you along the way.

feeds.title: LatinoFoodie
feeds.description: Based in Los Angeles, LatinoFoodie is one of the best sources for home cooks and foodies to discover original and adapted recipes that are a mix of traditional and modern interpretations of Mexican dishes. The lifestyle blog also explores travel destinations and their culinary offerings. LatinoFoodie offers articles educating readers about the history of Latin food and tells the story of top Latino chefs and how they became successful.
